notes.title: Major Update for Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific: New Maps and more!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=-dggLzJjzsE;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello Beach Invasion fans, today we announce the first major content update for Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific!
With this content update, Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific gets two new playable maps, Peleliu for the Japanese and Attu, Alaska for the Americans. The update also introduces:

 New weapons for each map, Type 11 LMG for Peleliu, M45 Quadmount and M3 Stuart for Alaska
 Two new enemy types for each map, DUKW(Amphibious Truck) and Seep(Sea Jeep) for Peleliu, and Fu-go balloons and Type-2 Ka-mi amphibious tanks for Alaska 
 The new M45 Quadmt. also replaces one of the 6-inch guns in the Philippines map
 GPU,CPU and memory optimization
 New music
 New weather conditions in the Alaska map: snow and blizzard
 Damaged trees can be broken in the Peleliu map
 Achivement system reworked: Wave completions changed:  10>5, 20>10, 50>20, 100>35, 200>50, 500>75, 1000>100

Other changes:


 Supply box intervals increased to 45 from 30 for COOP
 Siren sounds decreased
 Rocket trucks aiming and firing reworked
 Plane health and speed reworked
 Infantry movement reworked in the Philippines
 Killcams fixed
 Weapon healths reworked
 Fog amount adjusted for each map
 Landing crafts do not disappear immediately when going back
 Ricochet chances increased
 Max FPS limited for resource consumption
 Aiming for weapons reworked
 Mouse sensitivity reworked
 Sound attenuation adjusted

notes.title: Release Announcement: Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific is out!!!
notes.notes:
Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific
Adjust your sights, fix your bayonets and dig into your trenches, we have some good news for you!  We are happy to announce the release of the next installment in the Beach Invasion series! This time we are taking you to the tropical islands in the Pacific during the Second World War, to defend against endless invasion forces!

So let's talk about the unique features of our sequel game: 


🎮 The biggest one being the online COOP feature, which will allow two players to play on a map , trying to defend against invaders together. (On a technical note, online multiplayer meant that almost all of the programming of the game had to be re-written from scratch.)

🌏Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific allows you to play from both sides(Japanese and American), in two new maps! You can either play as a Japanese defender on the Iwo Jima map, or as an American-Filipino defender on the Philippines map.

🎯New weapon types! We are introducing new weapons such as the automatic firing triple barreled AA gun, or the naval gun batteries of the Fort Drum(concrete battleship).

⚔️New enemy types! In addition to infantry, tanks, boat and planes, we now added rocket-launcher on tanks, trucks, and boats, as well as amphibious vehicles and heavy bombers that drop incendiary napalm bombs!

💥Updated and improved visual and sound effects! Flares, lighting and much more!


Our team worked very hard to deliver a bug-free game with all feature completed, but as we are a small team, some small bugs here and there might have slipped our eyes. If you encounter any problems, please report them, cheers! Have a nice holiday season!

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes:
First update of the year 2023 is here! We are planning some big things for 2023 but for now we bring you the first update which deals with some of the known issues, also with some language updates!


 Steam community items added! (trading cards, badges etc.)
 Waves don't end abruptly any more
 Poison gas upgrade does no longer decrease penetration power of shells
 Japanese language updated
 Italian language added
 Some minor bugfixes

notes.title: Update Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thanks again for your support and patience. 
Today we are happy to announce our first update for our game, addressing some of the immediate issues about the game according to the feedback we got from you:

 You can now resume from where you left
 Mouse invert axis added to the options menu
 You can now scroll through weapons with the mouse wheel
 You can now hide and unhide the hud (press h) to take more cinematic shots
 Adjusted camera movement when switching between weapons
 Updated German language and added Hungarian language
 Increased the number and efficiency of the troops on our side
 Other bugfixes
